Sawian.name: Experiment
Sawian.description:
The one we all come from?
Probably not natural.
Sawian.gameplay: The base for almost all other species

Sawian.name: Orange
Sawian.description:
Slow and stupid brute.
Dangerously tough. Resilient.

Sawian.name: Milky
Sawian.description:
Good marksmen.
Usually have the best guns.

Sawian.name: Leapy
Sawian.description:
Glass cannon.
Good to get a job done quick.
Sawian.gameplay:
Very agile, but very frail
Can infinitely chain roll pounces

Sawian.name: Chompy
Sawian.description:
Beware of them in water.
Found around water as well.
Sawian.gameplay:
Swims very fast
Massive stat boosts in water

Sawian.name: Roza
Sawian.description:
Bullets cause leg injury.
Supportive unit. Fodder.

Sawian.name: Voyager
Sawian.gameplay:
Quick but frail.
Moving slowly allows you to camouflage

Sawian.name: Baron
Sawian.description:
Use heavy weapons, and gain distance.
Hit them first, and hit them hard.
Sawian.gameplay:
Extremely massive health pool
Extremely strong kicks
No health regeneration

Sawian.name: Chik
Sawian.description:
Watch the skies.
Predict aerial ambushes.
Sawian.gameplay:
Can jump mid-air multiple times
Much higher aimspeed mid-air
Slow fall

Sawian.name: Crystal
Sawian.description:
Watch for their tongue.
Dangerous at close range.
Sawian.gameplay:
Slow reloads
Press W to tongue and grapple

Sawian.name: Velvet
Sawian.description:
If spat on, hold your ground.
Beware their endurance.
Sawian.gameplay:
Tanky, with bad weapon handling
Hold CTRL/LMB to spit out cobweb

Sawian.name: Icke
Sawian.description:
They will rush you.
Set an ambush.
Sawian.gameplay:
Bad weapon handling, very high jumps
VERY strong kicks
Higher move, reload and aim speed the lower your HP is

Sawian.name: Shelly
Sawian.description:
No easy way around them.
Excessive force required.
Sawian.gameplay:
Fire immune
80% explosion resistance
25% fall damage resistance
Verytanky
Very Sluggish
Lowered health regeneration

Sawian.name: Dune
Sawian.description:
High level skill ; High level threat.
Do not treat lightly.
Sawian.gameplay:
Crouch over corpses to eat them and heal
Breathes underwater
Lowered health regeneration

Sawian.name: Albino
Sawian.description:
The one we all come from?
Probably not natural.
Sawian.gameplay:
Weak, frail and infit for combat
Basically hard mode
